Initial release offering paid, specialized database consulting services.

- Supports one-time delivery for schema design, SQL and index optimization, migration plans, backup and recovery, and performance troubleshooting.
- Implements a three-stage pay-to-use process: order creation, payment, then service execution.
- Service scope includes review/optimization, migration, backup, consistency, and capacity planning.
- Requires network and filesystem access permissions.
- Interactions are in Chinese.
